- 工作台 pages/workbench：项目检查与卡片展示

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from 'vue'
import { onShow } from '@dcloudio/uni-app'
import BottomNav from '../../components/BottomNav.vue'
import { useMainNav } from '../../composables/useMainNav'
import { PORTAL_ROUTES, PORTAL_TABS, go, reLaunch } from '../../composables/usePortalNav'
import { fetchHome, fetchStudyTab } from '../../utils/portalData'
import { SEED_HOME } from '../../mock/portalSeed'
import type { PortalArticle, PortalHomeData } from '../../types/portal'

const { go: goTab } = useMainNav()

/** 首页数据：优先真实接口，接口不可用/未登录时静默使用设计稿静态数据 */
const home = ref<PortalHomeData>(SEED_HOME)
const activeTab = ref<string>(PORTAL_TABS[0])
const studyArticles = ref<PortalArticle[]>(SEED_HOME.study[PORTAL_TABS[0]])
const studyCache = ref<Record<string, PortalArticle[]>>({ ...SEED_HOME.study })
let tabToken = 0

async function loadHome() {
  try {
    const data = await fetchHome()
    home.value = data
    studyCache.value = { ...studyCache.value, ...data.study }
    studyArticles.value = studyCache.value[activeTab.value] ?? data.study[PORTAL_TABS[0]]
  } catch { /* 保留静态数据，不弹提示 */ }
}
onShow(() => { void loadHome() })

/** 学习园地 tab 切换：按 tab 编码拉真实列表（苏住房C getStudyList） */
async function selectTab(tab: string) {
  if (activeTab.value === tab) return
  activeTab.value = tab
  studyArticles.value = studyCache.value[tab] ?? []
  const token = ++tabToken
  try {
    const rows = await fetchStudyTab(tab)
    if (token !== tabToken) return
    studyCache.value = { ...studyCache.value, [tab]: rows }
    studyArticles.value = rows
  } catch { /* 保留静态数据 */ }
}

/** 全部跳转均落到真实页面，不再用 toast 占位 */
function openNotice() { go(PORTAL_ROUTES.list('notice')) }
function openTodo() { go(PORTAL_ROUTES.list('task')) }
function openBanner() {
  const link = home.value.banner.linkUrl
  if (link && /^https?:\/\//i.test(link)) go(PORTAL_ROUTES.webview(link, home.value.banner.title))
  else reLaunch(PORTAL_ROUTES.workbench)
}
function openStudyMore() { go(PORTAL_ROUTES.list('study', activeTab.value)) }
function openNewsMore() { go(PORTAL_ROUTES.list('news')) }
function openArticle(a: PortalArticle, fromStudy: boolean) {
  let url = PORTAL_ROUTES.detail(a.detailType, a.id)
  if (fromStudy) url += `&tab=${encodeURIComponent(activeTab.value)}`
  if (a.linkUrl && /^https?:\/\//i.test(a.linkUrl)) url = PORTAL_ROUTES.webview(a.linkUrl, a.title)
  go(url)
}

const articleImageUrls = computed(() => [...studyArticles.value, ...home.value.news].map(a => a.image).filter((x): x is string => !!x))
function previewArticleImage(src: string) {
  const urls = articleImageUrls.value
  if (!urls.length) return
  uni.previewImage({ current: src, urls })
}
</script>

<template>
  <view class="screen app-screen">
    <view class="screen-content home-content">
      <view class="notice-card" role="button" @click="openNotice">
        <view class="notice-icon"><text class="notice-icon-glyph">⌁</text></view>
        <text class="notice-tag">通知公告</text>
        <text class="notice-text">{{ home.notice.title }}</text>
        <text class="notice-arrow">›</text>
      </view>

      <view class="todo-card" role="button" @click="openTodo">
        <view class="todo-icon"><text class="todo-icon-glyph">▤</text></view>
        <view class="todo-main">
          <view class="todo-title-row">
            <text class="todo-title">待办事项</text>
            <text class="todo-badge">{{ home.todoCount }}</text>
          </view>
          <text class="todo-sub">{{ home.todoText }}</text>
        </view>
        <text class="todo-more">共{{ home.todoCount }}项待办 ›</text>
      </view>

      <view class="banner" role="button" @click="openBanner">
        <text class="banner-small">{{ home.banner.small }}</text>
        <text class="banner-title">{{ home.banner.title }}</text>
        <text class="banner-sub">{{ home.banner.sub }}</text>
        <view class="banner-art" />
      </view>

      <view class="section-heading">
        <text class="section-heading-title">学习园地</text>
        <text class="section-heading-more" role="button" @click="openStudyMore">更多 ›</text>
      </view>
      <scroll-view class="scroll-tabs" scroll-x>
        <view
          v-for="tab in home.tabs"
          :key="tab"
          class="scroll-tab"
          :class="{ active: activeTab === tab }"
          @click="selectTab(tab)"
        >{{ tab }}</view>
      </scroll-view>
      <view v-for="(a, i) in studyArticles" :key="'l' + i" class="article-card" role="button" @click="openArticle(a, true)">
        <view class="article-main">
          <text class="article-title">{{ a.title }}</text>
          <view class="article-foot">
            <text v-if="a.tag" class="article-tag">{{ a.tag }}</text>
            <text class="article-meta">{{ a.meta }}</text>
            <text v-if="a.trailing" class="article-trailing">{{ a.trailing }}</text>
          </view>
        </view>
        <image
          v-if="a.image"
          class="article-image"
          :src="a.image"
          mode="aspectFill"
          role="button"
          @click.stop="previewArticleImage(a.image)"
        />
      </view>

      <view class="section-heading">
        <text class="section-heading-title">新闻公告</text>
        <text class="section-heading-more" role="button" @click="openNewsMore">查看全部 ›</text>
      </view>
      <view v-for="(a, i) in home.news" :key="'n' + i" class="article-card" role="button" @click="openArticle(a, false)">
        <view class="article-main">
          <text class="article-title">{{ a.title }}</text>
          <view class="article-foot">
            <text v-if="a.tag" class="article-tag">{{ a.tag }}</text>
            <text class="article-meta">{{ a.meta }}</text>
            <text v-if="a.trailing" class="article-trailing">{{ a.trailing }}</text>
          </view>
        </view>
        <image
          v-if="a.image"
          class="article-image"
          :src="a.image"
          mode="aspectFill"
          role="button"
          @click.stop="previewArticleImage(a.image)"
        />
      </view>
    </view>
    <BottomNav active="home" @select="goTab" />
  </view>
</template>

const { chromium } = require('@playwright/test')

const BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:8095'
const EDGE = 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\msedge.exe'

const ROUTES = [
  ['首页', '/#/pages/home/index'],
  ['通知公告列表', '/#/pages/portal/list/index?type=notice'],
  ['新闻公告列表', '/#/pages/portal/list/index?type=news'],
  ['学习园地列表', '/#/pages/portal/list/index?type=study&tab=%E6%94%BF%E7%AD%96%E6%B3%95%E8%A7%84'],
  ['资讯中心列表', '/#/pages/portal/list/index?type=message'],
  ['任务中心列表', '/#/pages/portal/list/index?type=task'],
  ['公告详情', '/#/pages/portal/detail/index?type=notice&id=seed-notice-1'],
  ['文章详情', '/#/pages/portal/detail/index?type=article&id=seed-news-1'],
  ['任务详情', '/#/pages/portal/detail/index?type=task&id=seed-task-1'],
  ['个人设置', '/#/pages/portal/setting/index'],
  ['个人信息', '/#/pages/portal/profile/index'],
  ['外链页(无效链接空态)', '/#/pages/portal/webview/index?url=&title=%E6%B5%8B%E8%AF%95'],
]

;(async () => {
  const browser = await chromium.launch({ executablePath: EDGE, headless: true })
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } })
  const page = await ctx.newPage()
  const errors = []
  page.on('pageerror', e => errors.push(`PAGEERROR ${e.message}`))
  page.on('console', m => { if (m.type() === 'error') errors.push(`CONSOLE ${m.text().slice(0, 160)}`) })

  for (const [name, route] of ROUTES) {
    const errsBefore = errors.length
    await page.goto(BASE + route, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' }).catch(e => errors.push(`NAV ${name}: ${e.message}`))
    await page.waitForTimeout(900)
    const bodyText = (await page.locator('body').innerText().catch(() => '')).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 110)
    const newErrs = errors.slice(errsBefore)
    console.log(`${name.padEnd(20)} | text="${bodyText}" | errors=${newErrs.length}`)
    newErrs.forEach(e => console.log(`    ${e}`))
  }

  // 跳转链路验证：首页 -> 通知公告 -> 详情 -> 返回
  await page.goto(BASE + '/#/pages/home/index', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' })
  await page.waitForTimeout(700)
  await page.locator('.notice-card').click()
  await page.waitForTimeout(700)
  const afterNotice = page.url()
  console.log(`JUMP home->notice: ${afterNotice.replace(BASE, '')}`)
  await page.locator('.article-card').first().click().catch(() => {})
  await page.waitForTimeout(700)
  console.log(`JUMP notice->detail: ${page.url().replace(BASE, '')}`)

  // 我的页菜单跳转
  await page.goto(BASE + '/#/pages/mine/index', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' })
  await page.waitForTimeout(700)
  for (const [idx, label] of [[0, '资讯中心'], [1, '任务中心'], [2, '个人设置']]) {
    await page.locator('.menu-row').nth(idx).click()
    await page.waitForTimeout(600)
    console.log(`JUMP mine->${label}: ${page.url().replace(BASE, '')}`)
    await page.goto(BASE + '/#/pages/mine/index', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' })
    await page.waitForTimeout(400)
  }

  console.log(`\nTOTAL_ERRORS=${errors.length}`)
  await browser.close()
  process.exit(errors.length ? 1 : 0)
})().catch(e => { console.error('FATAL', e); process.exit(2) })
